Game Overview

At its heart, Create Bombardiro Crocodilo is a platformer game about unleash chaos by fusing crocodiles with absurd objects to create powerful hybrids. Strategize as a Croc Tank or soar as a Croc Helicopter in a destructible world. Battle quirky enemies like Goose Bombardiro, strive for a high score, and enjoy the fun of hybrid survival on mobile or PC.
